rationale: EGFR-TKIs benefit only EGFR-activating-mutant NSCLC; no benefit (often harm) in EGFR-wild-type.
ALK/ROS1 inhibitors benefit only ALK/ROS1-rearranged tumours.
BRAF inhibitors benefit only BRAF-V600-mutant tumours; paradoxical activation in wild-type.
KRAS-G12C inhibitors benefit only G12C-mutant tumours.
Anti-HER2 agents benefit only HER2-overexpressing/amplified (or HER2-mutant) tumours.
PARP inhibitors benefit is greatest in BRCA/HRD-deficient tumours but ovarian maintenance shows broader benefit; off-HRR populations enrich for failure.
CDK4/6 inhibitors are used in HR-positive/HER2-negative breast cancer; outside HR+ context the leverage drops.
JAK inhibitors benefit JAK-driven myeloproliferative/immune diseases (indication-defined); off-driver solid tumours (colorectal/pancreatic) lack the driver.
